verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's first-party docs show clean markdown as a core output. The Python API exposes `result.markdown`, the CLI supports `-o markdown`, and 'Fit Markdown' heuristic filtering and BM25 filtering strip noise, with links converted into numbered citations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of markdown cleanliness/quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: Generate Clean Markdown: Perfect for RAG pipelines or direct ingestion into LLMs.
Fit Markdown: Heuristic-based filtering to remove noise and irrelevant parts for AI-friendly processing.
Converts page links into a numbered reference list with clean citations.
